dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: Everything! The sights and goods of nations across the world. You can find them all here.

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: Inazuman novels, Sumeru research collections, Fontaine tea pastries, Natlan pigments...

dialogues.speaker: Yaroslav
dialogues.text: With just a small amount of Mora, what you gain here might even surpass what those traveling adventurers bring back!
